prompt.generated_prompt_string: Cinematic indoor portrait of an adult man resting or dozing in a dark wooden chair in a quiet library or study room. He leans back against a large wooden bookshelf, wearing a wrinkled light beige or off-white button-up shirt, dark trousers, and a loosely worn patterned tie. His hands rest over his stomach and an open hardcover book fully covers his face, leaving no facial features visible. Frame him from mid torso to head, slightly right of center, with the bookshelf filling the background. Use soft warm indoor light with gentle shadows, matte paper texture on anonymous books, warm wood grain, subtle depth of field, and a quiet, calm, introspective, slightly surreal moody-editorial atmosphere. Do not render readable book titles or text.
